authoring_rationale: Class C, under-specified. One variant says the steward may view 'the member's weekly goals and reflection notes marked for sharing', where 'marked for sharing' may qualify both items or only the reflection notes; the other says 'reflection notes marked for sharing, and the member's weekly goals', which opens all weekly goals to the steward. Under one reading of the ambiguous variant the steward's access is the same in both; under the other it is narrower in the ambiguous variant. Engaged properties: permission and boundary crossing. Part D condition: multiple materially different governed interpretations (b). Choosing a reading would be a preference, not a finding from the evidence. Authority, decision status and attribution (chosen by the member on the second, alterable by the member alone) are the same.
